costs: sacrifice costs consume only battlefield permanents
other costs are delegated to the producing spell or ability
timing: permanents enter only through represented actions, resolution, effects, and rules
a resolving permanent spell keeps the CR 400.7a logical incarnation while receiving a battlefield timestamp
targets: an unqualified target domain defaults to the shared battlefield
all controller presentation lists participate in the same battlefield target domain
another public zone must be named explicitly by the target schema
choices: controller presentation does not change shared-zone membership
attachment placement is represented by identity rather than client screen coordinates
hidden_information: face-down battlefield objects remain public objects while their hidden identity is viewer-scoped
apnap: simultaneous battlefield entry and triggered ability ordering are delegated to their producing rule families
layers: effective battlefield characteristics use the canonical layer evaluator
complete continuous-effect dependencies remain a separate trust blocker
replacement_effects: entry replacements are applied before or during the represented zone transition
complete replacement-choice ordering remains a separate trust blocker
copy: a card copy on the battlefield is categorized as a permanent
a resolving permanent spell copy becomes the same token permanent object
complete CR 400.7 exception coverage remains blocked
control_change: battlefield storage follows the current controller
changing control preserves the object's battlefield identity
an attachment may remain controlled by a different player than the object it is attached to
zone_change: ordinary entry creates a new logical object
stack-to-battlefield resolution preserves the CR 400.7a logical object
battlefield-only state is reset at the ordinary zone-change boundary
source_leaves: leaving the battlefield ends permanent status
last-known information and source-leaves triggers are delegated to CR 603, 608, and 609

variants: Aura attached to another player's permanent
instant or sorcery card prevented from entering
legacy printed in-play wording normalized by Oracle
rulings: Master Transmuter — 2020-08-07 — A returned artifact put back onto the battlefield is a new object with no relation to its previous existence.
Kindred Equipment release ruling — 2008-04-01 — An Equipment may become attached to another player's creature while its controller retains control of the Equipment.
Bloodghast — 2025-07-25 — Landfall triggers for a land entering under a player's control for any reason, including play and effects.

implementation.component: CommanderEngine battlefield membership, zone movement, target domains, control changes, attachments, object identity, and StateProjector controller presentation

known_blockers: complete CR 400.7 zone-change exception coverage is not implemented
complete continuous-effect layer and dependency coverage is not implemented
complete replacement-effect ordering for battlefield entry is not implemented
complete Aura, Equipment, Fortification, and player-attachment grammar is not implemented
complete face-down battlefield characteristic handling is not implemented
the full Oracle corpus has not been proven to use only trusted cross-zone target and effect schemas
